name: watch-github
description: One daemon per session, a background task of that session, watches pull requests and branch tips and delivers comments, reviews, CI verdicts, head moves, label moves, conflicts, merges, and closes as messages instead of polls.

interface.shortDescription: PR, branch, and CI events as messages, not polls.
interface.longDescription: One watch call subscribes the session to a PR and its gate workflows, or to a branch tip through every push. One daemon per session polls GitHub through GraphQL, once a minute while something moves and every five while nothing does. Comments, reviews, CI verdicts, head moves, label moves, conflicts, merges, and closes arrive as messages, structure and URLs only, and as a log read with wait.
defaultPrompt: Push this and tell me when CI or a review comes back.
Did the pipeline pass for my last push?
Watch main and tell me when its CI settles.
